operations.title: WP37: universal charge law - every viable block-diagonal sheet (955/955) has its phase edge in the DOWN sector; J-routing is universal (zeroing H_12 kills J on all 848 mixed sheets <2.5e-15, leaves J exactly on all 107 unmixed); q_anchor = H_12.sin(phi) is class-constant per anchor: q_u=3.621318e-2 (rel 2.9e-5, exact), q_t=1.125347e-6 (rel 1.7e-8, exact), q_c=3.245237e-3 (approximate, genuine ~1% texture-level fluctuation partially correlated with block splitting Delta, corr 0.73); WP35's three-way theta typing explained as the q-law masked by Delta drift; ratios q_u/q_c=11.15, q_c/q_t=2885 (ledger 1978)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP37 - the charge law is universal across anchors; J-routing census complete at 955 sheets
operations.body: WP37 (ledger 1978, results/wp37_universal_charge.json, 5/5 gates) extends WP36 to all anchors. Facts: (1) 955/955 viable block-diagonal sheets carry the phase edge in the DOWN sector - the census is complete, no exception. (2) J-routing is universal: H_12 is the unique J valve on all 848 mixed sheets (u/t/c), and the down-loop product carries J on all 107 unmixed. (3) The charge law q_anchor = H_12.sin(phi): EXACT for u (2.9e-5) and t (1.7e-8 - the t-class reciprocal law was real but hidden in WP35 by Delta drift of the tiny fitted yc^2-yu^2 difference); APPROXIMATE at ~1% for c, a genuine texture-level fluctuation correlated with the block splitting Delta (0.73), no exact refinement found. (4) WP35's three-way theta typing is now fully explained: one q-law, three Delta behaviors. Open: closed-form identification of q_anchor as a magnitude monomial; the near-coincidence q_u/V_cb ~ q_c/V_ub ~ 0.87 unverified. WP11 stands - phi remains chart data.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP37 - universal charge law across flavor anchor classes
operations.body: WP37 (ledger 1978, results/wp37_universal_charge.json): the WP35/WP36 reciprocal-law structure generalizes to all flavor anchor classes. Universal facts: phase edge always in the down sector (955/955 viable sheets); the up-sector 2x2 block off-diagonal H_12 is the unique J valve on every mixed sheet; the charge q_anchor = H_12.sin(phi) is a class constant - exact for u (q_u=3.621e-2, rel 2.9e-5) and t (q_t=1.125e-6, rel 1.7e-8), approximate at ~1% for c (q_c=3.245e-3, genuine texture fluctuation tied to the block splitting). Ratios q_u/q_c=11.15, q_c/q_t=2885. All statements are chart-space theorems about the fitted ensemble; no claim of descent to the physical U(3)^3 quotient (WP11).
